What if Microsoft Excel was rewritten from scratch in pure Rust? 🦀✨

Meet GridCraft: a lightning-fast, memory-safe, clean-room spreadsheet engine built for the modern tech stack. 

🛑 The Problem:
Most spreadsheets rely on legacy codebases, bloated runtimes, or proprietary tech that makes them slow, insecure, and nearly impossible for modern AI agents or web apps to integrate cleanly.

🚀 Key Features:
• Advanced Calculation Engine: Dependency graphs, dynamic arrays, spilling, 500+ worksheet functions (including lambdas), and incremental recalculation.
• Full XLSX Compatibility: Flawless round-tripping of formulas, styles, themes, charts, PivotTables, and conditional formatting.
• Agent-Native via MCP: A built-in Model Context Protocol server lets AI agents and CLI tools drive every command, ribbon button, and menu item programmatically.
• Multi-Platform & WebAssembly: Compiles natively for macOS, Windows, Linux, and BSD, or straight to the browser with near-free undo snapshots via copy-on-write workbooks.

Whether you are an AI engineer building autonomous desktop data workflows, a full-stack dev looking for an embeddable high-performance web spreadsheet, or just a Rust enthusiast wanting to study a production-grade desktop architecture, GridCraft has you covered.

🔗 Explore the repo and drop a star:
https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft

Stop letting coding agents blindly write bad code. 🛑 

If you are tired of babysitting AI assistants that generate broken logic, skip tests, and cause architectural drift mid-session, it is time to upgrade your workflow. 

Meet Superpowers: a comprehensive software development methodology and agentic skills framework that transforms your AI tools into disciplined, TDD-driven engineering partners. 

Instead of jumping straight into code generation, Superpowers forces AI agents to pause, brainstorm designs, write structured implementation plans, isolate work via Git worktrees, and enforce strict test-driven development before touching your codebase. 

🔥 Key Features:
• Automated Session Bootstrapping: Intercepts early prompts to trigger proactive brainstorming and requirements gathering.
• Subagent-Driven Loops: Dispatches isolated tasks to fresh subagents, maintaining rigorous review cycles and multi-hour autonomous execution.
• Strict Engineering Guardrails: Enforces Red-Green-Refactor TDD, YAGNI, DRY, and automated severity-based code review gating.
• Universal Compatibility: Works natively with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Pi, and over a dozen other developer environments.

Whether you are scaffolding complex multi-file features autonomously over hours or eliminating regressions by forcing strict TDD protocols, Superpowers gives you predictable guardrails for AI-assisted engineering.

Check it out on GitHub and scale your autonomous workflows without sacrificing code quality:
https://github.com/obra/superpowers

Linux users, the holy grail of local file sharing with iPhones is finally here. 🍏🤝🐧

Who says you need proprietary Apple hardware to use AirDrop? If you are tired of jumping through hoops with cloud storage, messy web apps, or email drafts just to send a screenshot or build log from your iPhone to your Linux workstation, this tool is for you.

Introducing t4t5/omdrop-owl: a radio backend utility that bridges userspace AWDL (Apple Wireless Direct Link) stacks with standard MediaTek and Intel Wi-Fi chipsets. It lets you bring native AirDrop functionality straight to your Linux laptop—no Broadcom card required.

🔥 Notable Features:
• Dual operation modes supporting shared Wi-Fi coexistence on MediaTek cards and exclusive channel control on Intel hardware.
• Comprehensive hardware profile mapping system adapting to specific driver behaviors, monitor interface injection limitations, and channel constraints.
• Automated card testing tooling to help developers validate and benchmark new Wi-Fi chipsets and contribute community hardware profiles.
• Seamless integration with the omdrop ecosystem, maintaining compatibility with existing AWDL daemons, mDNS responders, and Bluetooth LE helpers.

Whether you are a cross-platform power user looking to streamline your daily workflow or a systems engineer diving deep into userspace packet injection, mac80211 monitor interfaces, and wireless protocol reverse engineering, this repository is a goldmine.

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/t4t5/omdrop-owl

Tired of bloated legacy office software that grinds your system to a halt? Meet DeckCraft: an open-source, memory-safe PowerPoint alternative written in pure Rust that unifies native UI, CLI scripting, and AI agent control via MCP. 🦀⚡

DeckCraft solves the problem of clunky presentation tools by offering a modular, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft PowerPoint. It lets you build, edit, open, save, and present slide decks natively across major desktop platforms, browsers, and terminal environments with full .pptx file compatibility.

Here is what makes DeckCraft a game-changer for your workflow:

🤖 Dual Human-Agent Control: Every UI button maps to a stable command ID, enabling full-featured automation via CLI, JSON control channels, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for LLM agents.
📄 Comprehensive Engine: Full PowerPoint .pptx reading and writing, PDF exports, custom slide sizes, morph transitions, and rich multimedia playback.
🎨 Advanced Toolset: Over 150 preset shapes with adjust handles, smart connectors, boolean shape merging, and complex gradient or pattern fills.
🚀 Modern Architecture: Built using high-performance Rust graphics pipelines (wgpu) targeting macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and modern web browsers.

Whether you are an AI engineer building LLM agent workflows, a scripter automating report generation in headless CI/CD pipelines, or a Rust developer studying high-performance cross-platform GUI architecture, DeckCraft delivers.

Check out the repository and start building today:
https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft

Ever struggle to explain complex system architecture without putting your readers to sleep? 🥱 

Transform abstract technical ideas into stunning interactive isometric figures, WebGL simulations, and production-ready SVG art with Anatomy.

Anatomy bridges the gap between AI-driven coding agents and high-end technical documentation. It provides a specialized Claude Code skill that designs and builds working, physical metaphors for abstract software concepts—like turning a pin-tumbler lock into a visual for cache keys. 

✨ Key Features:
• AI-Powered Conceptual Mapping: Automatically creates physical objects mirroring technical mechanics.
• Multi-Layered Rendering Support: Generates standalone SVGs, WebGL shaders for environmental effects, and 3D parts.
• Zero-Dependency Runtime: Runs using strictly Node.js built-in modules with no heavy npm installs.
• Self-Auditing Geometry: Built-in validation ensures structural integrity and prevents overlapping frames.

Whether you are a developer advocate, technical writer, or AI engineer, you can now turn dense architectural specs into engaging, interactive components in seconds.
